FewShots.input: Hiện tại có bao nhiêu dự án đang chạy?
Danh sách các dự án đang chạy
FewShots.query:
SELECT p.id, p.name AS project_name, p.code, p.priority, p.start_date, p.end_date
FROM projects p
WHERE p.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'::"ProjectStatus"
ORDER BY p.priority DESC, p.end_date NULLS LAST, p.id ASC
LIMIT 10;

FewShots.input: Dự án nào sắp tới deadline nhất?
FewShots.query:
SELECT p.id, p.name AS project_name, p.end_date, p.status
FROM projects p
WHERE p.end_date IS NOT NULL
  AND p.status NOT IN ('DONE'::"ProjectStatus", 'CANCELLED'::"ProjectStatus")
ORDER BY p.end_date ASC, p.id ASC
LIMIT 10;

FewShots.input: Liệt kê các task quá hạn
FewShots.query:
SELECT t.id, t.name AS task_name, t.deadline, t.status, p.name AS project_name, u.full_name AS assignee_name
FROM tasks t
JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.assignee_id
WHERE t.deadline < CURRENT_DATE
  AND t.status <> 'DONE'::"TaskStatus"
ORDER BY t.deadline ASC, t.id ASC
LIMIT 10;

FewShots.input: Danh sách task đang làm của dự án CRM
FewShots.query:
SELECT t.id, t.name AS task_name, t.status, t.priority, t.deadline, u.full_name AS assignee_name
FROM tasks t
JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.assignee_id
WHERE p.name ILIKE '%CRM%'
  AND t.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'::"TaskStatus"
ORDER BY t.deadline NULLS LAST, t.priority DESC, t.id ASC
LIMIT 10;

FewShots.input: Ai đang phụ trách các task urgent?
FewShots.query:
SELECT t.id, t.name AS task_name, p.name AS project_name, u.full_name AS assignee_name, t.deadline
FROM tasks t
JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.assignee_id
WHERE t.priority = 'URGENT'::"Priority"
  AND t.status <> 'DONE'::"TaskStatus"
ORDER BY t.deadline NULLS LAST, t.id ASC
LIMIT 10;

FewShots.input: Tiến độ từng milestone của dự án MTL
FewShots.query:
SELECT m.id, m.name AS milestone_name, m.status, m.due_date, m.completion_pct, m.task_count, m.done_count
FROM milestones m
JOIN projects p ON p.id = m.project_id
WHERE p.name ILIKE '%MTL%'
ORDER BY m.due_date NULLS LAST, m.id ASC
LIMIT 10;

FewShots.input: Tổng số giờ đã log theo từng dự án
FewShots.query:
SELECT p.id, p.name AS project_name, COALESCE(SUM(w.hours), 0) AS total_logged_hours
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN worklogs w ON w.project_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_logged_hours DESC, p.id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT w.work_date, u.full_name AS user_name, t.name AS task_name, p.name AS project_name, w.description, w.hours
FROM worklogs w
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id
LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.id = w.task_id
LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = w.project_id
ORDER BY w.work_date DESC, w.id DESC
LIMIT 10;

FewShots.input: Danh sách worklog của Nguyễn Văn A
FewShots.query:
SELECT w.work_date, t.name AS task_name, p.name AS project_name, w.description, w.hours
FROM worklogs w
JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id
LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.id = w.task_id
LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = w.project_id
WHERE u.full_name ILIKE '%Nguyễn Văn A%'
ORDER BY w.work_date DESC, w.id DESC
LIMIT 10;

FewShots.input: Mỗi thành viên đã log bao nhiêu giờ?
FewShots.query:
SELECT u.id, u.full_name AS user_name, COALESCE(SUM(w.hours), 0) AS total_logged_hours
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN worklogs w ON w.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.active = TRUE
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name
ORDER BY total_logged_hours DESC, u.id ASC
LIMIT 10;

FewShots.input: Tổng giờ đã log của từng dự án là bao nhiêu?
FewShots.query:
SELECT p.id, p.name AS project_name, p.total_hours
FROM projects p
ORDER BY p.total_hours DESC, p.id ASC
LIMIT 10;

FewShots.input: Task nào có tổng giờ log nhiều nhất?
FewShots.query:
SELECT t.id, t.name AS task_name, p.name AS project_name, COALESCE(SUM(w.hours), 0) AS total_logged_hours
FROM tasks t
JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_id
LEFT JOIN worklogs w ON w.task_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.name, p.name
ORDER BY total_logged_hours DESC, t.id ASC
LIMIT 10;

FewShots.input: Task nào đang bị blocker hoặc có issue?
FewShots.query:
SELECT t.id, t.name AS task_name, p.name AS project_name, t.status, t.issues, u.full_name AS assignee_name
FROM tasks t
JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.assignee_id
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(t.issues), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND t.status <> 'DONE'::"TaskStatus"
ORDER BY t.deadline NULLS LAST, t.id ASC
LIMIT 10;
